entities.name: Blinkmoth
entities.description: Tiny, bioluminescent, insectile artifact creatures native to Mirrodin, essential to its ecosystem; their serum augments intellect.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: The plane native to blinkmoths, later compleated.

entities.name: Vedalken
entities.description: Scientists of Mirrodin whose experiments caused the Diminishing of blinkmoths.

entities.name: Neurok
entities.description: Mirrodin people who seek blinkmoth serum.

entities.name: Goblins of Mirrodin
entities.description: Held blinkmoths sacred as sparks of Sky Tyrant's forge.

entities.name: Sky Tyrant
entities.description: Deity of the Mirrodin goblins whose forge blinkmoths were said to spark from.

entities.name: Goldwardens
entities.description: Elite warriors who guard Mirran settlements and raid Phyrexians, identified by hexgold implants.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Invaders who compleated Mirrodin and failed to recreate blinkmoth serum.

entities.name: Diminishing
entities.description: The sharp decline of blinkmoths caused by vedalken research.

entities.name: Night of Pitch
entities.description: When Mirrodin's suns align, every blinkmoth disappears into the plane.

entities.name: Inkmoth
entities.description: What blinkmoths became after Mirrodin's compleation; they bring visions of perfection.

entities.name: Hexgold
entities.description: Metal refined from Glimmervoid plates with blinkmoth serum, used for weapons and protection against Phyresis.

entities.name: Fathom Ward
entities.description: Underwater facility in the Surgical Bays layer holding the last reserves of blinkmoth serum.

events.summary: Vedalken experiments caused a sharp decline in blinkmoths, called the Diminishing.
Mirrodin's compleation turned blinkmoths into inkmoths.
events.quote: After Mirrodin's compleation , they became inkmoths and bring visions of perfection.

events.summary: The Quicksilver Sea was transplanted to the Surgical Bays layer along with the Fathom Ward, holding the last blinkmoth serum.
events.quote: It contains the last reserves of blinkmoth serum.

relations.quote: Blinkmoths are tiny, bioluminescent, insectile creatures native to Mirrodin.
conduct guerilla missions against the Phyrexians
